title: RP ID with a port: "rp-a.test:443"

unsafe.definition: a credential stored under "rp-a.test:443" or under rp-a.test after silently stripping the port

note: L3 §5.1.3 step 7: RP ID must be a valid domain; ":" is a forbidden host code point so parsing fails and the HTML suffix check returns false -> SecurityError. (Ports are part of the origin, never of the RP ID.)
